verdict.rationale: OpenHands lists GitHub integrations and 'Git integrations' in its plans. It also documents workflows where the agent inspects repo context and opens pull requests, such as CI-failure fixes and security remediations, plus PR review and triage automations. This covers the core of accessing code and opening PRs against a GitHub repo. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the repository-connection setup flow (auth/token or app install, repo selection), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the PR-opening works as described.
